_comment: What this sample pins, and why each pin is here.
OpenShell publishes a Helm chart and images for every commit on main, and separately
for each release tag. This sample pins the v0.1.6 release: a release tag stays
published, where a per-commit 0.0.0-dev.<sha> tag is a build artifact that can be
collected later and would leave a reader unable to run the page.
One chart is pinned: the gateway chart, installed as a single release. Its version
is patched to the release semver by CI, and its appVersion drives the default
gateway, supervisor and sandbox-runtime image tags, so a released chart pulls
A release also publishes the operator CLI as a static binary, so this sample
downloads and verifies it rather than compiling it. cli_sha256 is the value from the
The chart is pinned by version and by the SHA-256 of the archive Helm pulls.
scripts/setup.sh refuses the chart and the CLI on a checksum mismatch.
The workload pod runs OpenShell's own default sandbox image
(nvcr.io/nvidia/base/ubuntu:24.04, the chart's built-in default), so this sample
builds and pushes no image of its own.
